title: Sample mail and parsing into Messages

goal.statement: A directory of .eml files, including the shipped 9-12 samples over 3 consecutive days with a reply Thread, parses into Messages with sender, UTC date, subject and body, skipping any without a parseable date.
Given Messages, a Digest Day and an Owner, the Digest has the day's total, Senders ranked by count, Threads grouped by Normalised Subject with Needs Reply, and Action Items.
